audience.text: Go developers building server-side or cross-platform applications that require PDF processing capabilities without external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Split, merge, extract, rotate, reorder pages, manage page labels, and handle document metadata including Info dictionary and XMP packets.
capabilities.title: Page operations and metadata

capabilities.text: Build documents top-to-bottom using the Flow layout engine with automatic pagination for paragraphs, headings, images, tables, lists, and floating boxes.
capabilities.title: Content authoring with Flow engine

capabilities.text: Create and manipulate form fields including text boxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, combo boxes, list boxes, push buttons, and specialized field types with value round-tripping in JSON/FDF/XFDF.
capabilities.title: AcroForms and interactive fields

capabilities.text: Add and manage annotations including links, highlights, underlines, strikeouts, squares, circles, lines, ink, text, freetext, stamps, polygons, polylines, carets, file attachments, and redactions with auto-regenerated appearance streams.
capabilities.title: Annotations and interactive elements

capabilities.text: Draw vector graphics using paths, shapes, gradients, and tiling patterns; import and render SVG 1.1 content including shapes, gradients, clipping, masks, and text.
capabilities.title: Vector graphics and SVG

capabilities.text: Detect tables from page geometry using TableAbsorber and convert to DOCX, XLSX, and EPUB with real tables, headers, and styling preserved.
capabilities.title: Table detection and Office conversion

capabilities.text: Validate structural integrity, PDF/A archival conformance (1A/1B/2A/2B/3A/3B), and PDF/UA accessibility compliance with detailed reporting and conversion assistance.
capabilities.title: PDF/A and PDF/UA validation

capabilities.text: Perform OCR on scanned pages, generate document summaries, answer questions via chat with conversation history, and create alt-text for figures using AI copilots over OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
capabilities.title: AI document analysis

limitations.text: Viewer permissions are enforced by PDF viewers, not by the library itself.
Linearization cannot be combined with encryption or digital signing in the same document.
Certificate-based encryption accepts RSA recipients only; elliptic curve recipients are not supported.
SearchText and ReplaceText match within a single text line only; queries spanning line breaks are not found.
The built-in renderer does not support mesh shadings (PDF shading types 4-7).
Table does not yet support content-driven auto-fit column widths, per-side border dash patterns, or RowSpan groups splitting across page breaks.

problems_solved.text: Enables PDF document creation, editing, and conversion entirely in Go without requiring native libraries or CGo bindings.
Provides a high-level Flow layout engine for building documents from structured content like paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists with automatic pagination.
Supports document security through password encryption (AES-128/AES-256/RC4), certificate-based encryption, and digital signatures (PKCS#7, PAdES, timestamps).
Offers AI-powered document analysis including OCR, summarization, chat-based Q&A, and alt-text generation via OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

product_summary.text: Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Go is a pure Go library for creating, editing, rendering, signing, encrypting, converting, and validating PDF documents without CGo, native libraries, or third-party dependencies.

workflows.name: Document creation and layout
workflows.text: Developers create new documents using NewDocument or NewDocumentFromFormat, then use the Flow layout engine to add paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists with automatic pagination.

workflows.name: Document merging and splitting
workflows.text: Developers split documents into per-page files using Split() or merge multiple documents using Append() to combine pages in place.

workflows.name: Form filling and validation
workflows.text: Developers read and write AcroForm field values using Form API methods, export/import data in JSON/FDF/XFDF formats, and flatten forms to make them non-editable.

workflows.name: Document security and signing
workflows.text: Developers encrypt documents with passwords or certificates, apply digital signatures with PKCS#7/PAdES support, and verify existing signatures for integrity.

workflows.name: Content rendering and export
workflows.text: Developers render pages to images (PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF), convert to HTML/SVG/Markdown, and extract text with layout information.

workflows.name: Document comparison and redaction
workflows.text: Developers compare documents page-by-page or flat, identify word-level changes, and apply redactions to permanently remove sensitive content.
